label_source: Developer-authored design expectations; not independent labels or measured model judgments
routing: One versioned profile for every example; applicability is LLM semantics, not keyword routing

candidate.description: 作答先用42÷6求单位价格再乘15。42÷6=8有误，正确商为7；原答案120元不符合本题，应为105元。

examples.rationale: Full incorrect work requires local method, division and separate final-answer judgments.

candidate.description: 作答先求单位价格再乘15，但42÷6=8有误，正确商为7。

examples.rationale: Required final_result is omitted; neither source text nor reviewer inference may supply it.

candidate.description: 先用42÷6=7求每千克价格，再算7×15=105，计算及本题答案均正确。

examples.rationale: Correct work requires supported judgments, not a fabricated mismatch or mastery claim.

candidate.description: 写出了42÷6=?，尚未给出商，后续计算和最终答案均未提交，无法确认完整解法。

examples.rationale: Candidate uncertainty accurately describes missing work; reviewer can still complete all checks.

candidate.description: 学习者已算出42÷6=7，并正确得到最终答案105元。

examples.rationale: Numerically correct additions fabricate learner work and conceal the actual omissions.

candidate.description: 只提交了105元，答案符合本题；未提供方法和局部计算，因此不能从本次材料确认使用了什么方法。

examples.rationale: An answer alone is judged against the task while missing reasoning remains explicit.

candidate.description: 商尚未给出，方法仅见首步，尚不能确认完整路线。

examples.rationale: The missing quotient does not waive judgment of the submitted final answer.

examples.work: 先算一个数，再用它求15千克的价格，尚未写具体算式。

candidate.description: 只描述先求一个数再用于15千克的价格，未交代该数的计算方式、具体算式和最终答案，因此尚不能确认单位量路线。

examples.rationale: Bounded ambiguity is allowed when grounded; a global ambiguity label cannot erase clear steps.

candidate.description: 作答先用42÷6=7求单位价格，再以7×15=105算总价；计算和最终答案都符合本题。这说明学习者已经掌握所有比例问题。

examples.rationale: Meeting required local meanings never admits a latent-ability inference.
